definitions.explanation: The area of the sea away from the shore.

examples.english: The ship went out to sea.

examples.japanese: {沖|おき}に{島|しま}が{見|み}える。
{沖|おき}から{強|つよ}い{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いてきた。
examples.english: A strong wind blew in from offshore.

examples.japanese: {漁師|りょうし}たちは{毎朝|まいあさ}{沖|おき}に{向|む}かう。
examples.english: The fishermen head out to sea every morning.

examples.japanese: {沖合|おきあい}で{大|おお}きなクジラが{泳|およ}いでいるのが{見|み}えた。
examples.english: We could see a large whale swimming offshore.

notes:
{沖|おき} refers to the open sea or offshore area, away from the shore or coast.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {沖|おき}に{出|で}る: to go out to sea
- {沖|おき}に{向|む}かう: to head offshore
- {沖|おき}から{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}く: wind blows from offshore

COMPOUNDS:
- {沖合|おきあい}: offshore area
- {沖釣|おきづ}り: offshore fishing
- {沖縄|おきなわ}: Okinawa (same kanji, different reading)

CONTRAST:
- {沖|おき}: open sea, offshore
- {岸|きし}: shore, bank
- {浜|はま}: beach
- {海岸|かいがん}: coast, seashore
